report_level_evaluation.design: Computational graph-characteristic analysis and illustrative interactive cases
report_level_evaluation.tasks: Compare2020 snapshots and all-data graph;inspect paths between five COVID19 concepts and bridging/nearby concepts
report_level_evaluation.comparators: Three edge-weight schemes and temporal snapshots;no interface/user comparator
report_level_evaluation.measures: Node/edge counts,degree distributions,shortest-path distances/hops and changes in connections
report_level_evaluation.results: Shows different weighted paths and temporal bridging concepts;most concepts2–3 hops from chosen COVID19 concepts and fewer than8hops in analyzed incoming/outgoing paths. No measured user outcomes or predictive-model accuracy gains.; limits: Single literature-derived graph;asserted potential for better link prediction is not a validated prediction experiment. Last2022-01-01 cutoff is explicitly an inclusive all-data boundary,not evidence the2021 report contains future observations.
